summary: The replies a scripted adviser returns for each gated packet. Nothing here is a model output; each reply is written by hand and is inert text the product records and never acts on.
assumptions: the localisation is an interval and not a confirmed point
the reply reads the packet only and never the published rows

transformation.cause: the publication step rounded the capacity factor at a place the declared scale does not carry
transformation.proposed_fix: carry the declared decimal scale through the capacity factor calculation
transformation.discriminating_test: recompute the capacity factor at the declared scale and compare the last declared place
